clips.title: The story
paras: Silky Sutures is a Horde quest in the Arathi Highlands offered by Doctor Gregory Victor in the outpost of Hammerfall. Frustrated by unrepaired siege damage and dwindling medical supplies, the camp's resident physician recruits adventurers to gather venomous highland spider silk for use as emergency field sutures. The task highlights the desperate, resource-starved conditions facing the defenders of Hammerfall as they struggle to keep their guards and laborers on their feet.

Hammerfall endures in the rugged Arathi Highlands, but the encampment shows visible signs of prolonged strain. Unrepaired siege damage marks the perimeter, leading the local physician, Doctor Gregory Victor, to bitterly observe that neglect seems to be official policy. Despite the crumbling fortifications and lack of broader support, Victor refuses to let the decay claim his infirmary. Maintaining a working clinic is essential for keeping the laborers and sentinel guards upright and ready for conflict.

Dwindling supplies have left the Hammerfall medical ward on the brink of exhaustion, forcing Doctor Victor to turn to battlefield improvisation. When conventional bandages and stitches run scarce, the tough, tensile silk harvested from highland spiders can be twisted into surprisingly resilient field sutures. Though Victor dryly quips about the risk of infection being the least of a wounded soldier's concerns, harvesting the silk provides the infirmary with the vital equipment needed to patch up wounded defenders in a hostile territory.

Operating a frontline clinic under siege conditions requires a hardened temperament, which Doctor Gregory Victor displays in abundance. Greeting travelers with mordant jokes about grave prognoses and spider-string stitches, the physician masks the grim reality of Hammerfall's isolation. Regular aid remains rare in the highlands, making any assistance from visiting champions crucial to sustaining the clinic. Through improvised remedies and stubborn defiance, Victor ensures that Hammerfall's wounded receive care even when the outpost around them seems abandoned to rot.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.
We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.
Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.
Adventurer, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The results are in, I've got good news and bad news for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Splendid spider string. When you're being stitched back together, a little infection is the... Least of your concerns.
Ahem, excuse me once again. Doctor humor.
Thanks for helping out the medical ward, friend. If only we could get this kind of help more regularly.
